model: localhost protocol stub; no live language model

checks.name: Session plugin discovery
checks.evidence: The native plugin list includes the --plugin-dir fixture.

checks.name: Manual namespaced skill expansion
checks.evidence: The host sends the skill body to the local Messages endpoint.

checks.name: Startup and prompt hooks execute and deliver context
checks.evidence: Both event markers reach the local model request.

checks.name: Native resume lifecycle
checks.evidence: A resumed print session fires SessionStart with source=resume.

checks.name: Native compaction and context refresh
checks.evidence: The host fires PreCompact and SessionStart(compact); refreshed context reaches the next request.

checks.name: Manual-only skill and sibling session isolation
checks.evidence: A fresh session receives no skill body without explicit invocation.

checks.name: Session-only plugin loading
checks.evidence: A fresh invocation without --plugin-dir receives no fixture hook context and runs no fixture hooks.

unverified: On/off supersession within an existing conversation
